question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be three non-zero non-coplanar vectors. Let the position vectors of four points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>C</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>D</mi></math> be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo>  </mo><mi>λ</mi><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> respectively. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> are coplanar, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi></math> is :

solution.text:
Given,

a→,b→ and c→ be three non-zero non-coplanar vectors,

Also the position vectors of four points A, B, C and D be a→-b→+c→,  λa→-3b→+4c→, -a→+2b→-3c→ and 2a→-4b→+6c→ respectively,

So, AB→=(λ-1)a→-2b→+3c→

AC→=-2a→+3b→-4c→

AD→=a→-3b→+5c→

Now using the condition of coplanar we get,

λ-1-23-23-41-35=0

⇒(λ-1)(15-12)+2(-10+4)+3(6-3)=0

⇒(λ-1)=1⇒λ=2
